answer: The node2vec paper (Grover & Leskovec, 2016) did not use one fixed training count. It varied the labeled training fraction from 1% to 90% of labeled nodes. Using the dataset sizes (BlogCatalog 10,312 nodes; PPI 3,890 nodes; Wikipedia 4,777 nodes), the approximate absolute training counts are: BlogCatalog about 103 to 9,281; PPI about 39 to 3,501; Wikipedia about 48 to 4,299.
